qe: In India's balance of payments, which of the following is recorded in the current account?
qh: भारत के भुगतान संतुलन (BoP) में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा चालू खाते में दर्ज होता है?
oe: Foreign direct investment received
Remittances sent by Indians working abroad
External commercial borrowing by a company
Foreign portfolio investment in Indian shares
oh: प्राप्त प्रत्यक्ष विदेशी निवेश (FDI)
विदेश में काम करने वाले भारतीयों द्वारा भेजी गई प्रेषण राशि
किसी कंपनी द्वारा बाह्य वाणिज्यिक उधार
भारतीय शेयरों में विदेशी पोर्टफोलियो निवेश
e: BoP ke chaalu khate (current account) me woh sabhi len-den aate hain jo vaastu tatha sevaon ke vyapaar, aay (income) aur ek-tarfa hastantaron se jude hain; inme videsh me kaam karne wale bharatiyon ke 'prashan' - remittances - ek-tarfa hastantaran hote hain, isliye woh chaalu khate me darj hote hain. Iske alava chaalu khate me vastuon ka niryat-aayat (trade balance), software jaisi sevaon ka vyapaar tatha videshi nivesh se milne wale byaaj-dividend (income) bhi aate hain. FDI, external commercial borrowing tatha FPI - teeno capital account (ya financial account) me darj hote hain kyunki ye dhan (capital) ke pravaah ya daayitva (liability) banate hain, aay ke nahi. Isi karan woh teeno vikalp galat hain. Bharatiya BoP ka dhanda bada hissa chaalu khate ke ghaate se juda hai, isliye samanya taur par chaalu-khata ghaata dikhta hai. Exam point: chaalu khata = vastu tatha seva vyapaar plus aay plus ek-tarfa hastantaran (remittances); capital khata = FDI, FPI, ECB jaise poonji-pravah.

qe: India's import bill is dominated by which single commodity, making it the most important factor behind a widening trade deficit?
qh: भारत के आयात बिल में किस एक वस्तु का बोलबाला है, जिसके कारण व्यापार घाटा बढ़ता है?
oe: Gold
Crude petroleum
Electronic goods
Fertilisers
oh: स्वर्ण
कच्चा पेट्रोलियम
इलेक्ट्रॉनिक सामान
उर्वरक
e: Bharat ke aayat me sabse bada hissa kachcha petroliyam (crude petroleum) ka hota hai, kyunki desh ki tel-sphodhan shalayein apni zaroorat ka bahut bada hissa videshi kachche tel se poorti karti hain. Isi wajah se jab antarrashtriya bazaar me kachche tel ke daam badh jaate hain, bharat ka aayat bill badh jaata hai, vyapaar ghaata (trade deficit) chaude ho jaata hai, rupee par dabav aata hai tatha (kai baar) mahangai badh jaati hai. Isliye crude petroleum wala vikalp sahi hai. Sona (gold) bharat ka ek bada aayat hai, lekin woh crude tel ke aayat se kam hota hai aur woh zyada aabhushan aur nivesh ki wajah se aata hai, isliye woh pehla sthan nahi paata. Electronic saamaan bhi bharat ka bada aayat hai, par usse bhi petro-product aayat zyada rahta hai; urvarak (fertiliser) bhi aayaat hota hai, lekin kachche tel jitna bada nahi. Isliye is prashn me asli drishti crude petroleum par hi rakhni chahiye. Exam point: bharat ka sabse bada aayat = kachcha petroliyam; iske daam badhne se vyapaar ghaata tatha chaalu-khata ghaata badhte hain.

qe: Special Economic Zones (SEZs) in India are governed by which Act, and what was the country's first export processing zone (EPZ)?
qh: भारत के विशेष आर्थिक क्षेत्र (SEZ) किस अधिनियम के अंतर्गत संचालित होते हैं, तथा देश का पहला निर्यात प्रसंस्करण क्षेत्र (EPZ) कौन-सा था?
oe: Foreign Trade (Development and Regulation) Act, 1992; Noida
SEZ Act, 2005; Kandla
Industrial Policy Resolution, 1991; Chennai
Companies Act, 2013; Surat
oh: विदेश व्यापार (विकास एवं विनियमन) अधिनियम, 1992; नोएडा
SEZ अधिनियम, 2005; कांडला
औद्योगिक नीति संकल्प, 1991; चेन्नई
कंपनी अधिनियम, 2013; सूरत
e: Bharat me SEZ ki shuruaat kaa apne niryat-prasanskarit kshetron (EPZ) se hui; pehla EPZ 1965 me Kandla (Gujarat) me banaya gaya. Uske baad 2000 me nai SEZ niti aayi aur 2005 me SEZ Act pass hua, jiske tehat aaj SEZ chalte hain; isi kanoon ke tehat ab SEZ me kisi bhi videshi ya gharelu kamparni ko kar-chhoot tatha aasaan seema-shulk prakriya milti hai, lekin unhe niryat ka pura kaam karna hota hai. Kandla ke baad SEEPZ Mumbai, Noida, Falta, Cochin, Chennai aur Visakhapatnam jaise EPZ bane, aur 2000 ke baad woh SEZ me badal gaye. Isliye 'SEZ Act, 2005' tatha 'Kandla' wali jodi sahi hai. Foreign Trade (Development and Regulation) Act 1992 videsh vyapaar ke samanya niyamatan ka kanoon hai, SEZ ka nahi; Industrial Policy Resolution 1991 udarikaran ki niti thi, kanoon nahi; Companies Act 2013 company ke gathan se juda hai. Exam point: pehla EPZ = Kandla (1965, Gujarat); aaj SEZ = SEZ Act 2005 ke tehat; iske teen lakshan - niryat par jor, kar-suvidha, ek khidki manzuri.

qe: When the rupee depreciates against the US dollar, what is its most likely effect on India's exports and imports?
qh: जब रुपया अमेरिकी डॉलर के मुकाबले अवमूल्यित होता है, तो भारत के निर्यात तथा आयात पर उसका सर्वाधिक संभावित प्रभाव क्या होता है?
oe: Exports become expensive and imports become cheaper
Exports become cheaper for foreign buyers and imports become costlier
Both exports and imports become cheaper
There is no effect on either trade or remittances
oh: निर्यात महँगा हो जाता है तथा आयात सस्ता
विदेशी खरीदारों के लिए निर्यात सस्ता हो जाता है तथा आयात महँगा हो जाता है
निर्यात तथा आयात दोनों सस्ते हो जाते हैं
व्यापार तथा प्रेषण पर कोई प्रभाव नहीं पड़ता
e: Jab rupeya dollar ke mukable kamzor hota hai (yaani ek dollar kharidne ke liye zyada rupaye dene padte hain), to bharat ka saamaan videshi kharidaron ke liye sasta ho jaata hai - kyunki unhe utna hi dollar dene par zyada rupaye ki keemat milti hai. Isliye niryat (exports) badhne me madad milti hai. Ulta, videshi saamaan aur kachcha tel bharat me mahnga padta hai, isliye aayat (imports) me lagat badh jaati hai, jo kai baar vyaapaar ghaate ko chauda karti hai. Isi wajah se rupeye ka kamzor hona 'niryat ke liye faaydemand' tatha 'aayat ke liye mehnga' hota hai. 'Niryat mehnga aur aayat sasta' wala vikalp ulta hai, isliye galat hai; 'dono sasta' wala bayan bhi ganit se mel nahi khaata. Videshi bhraman tatha videshi nivesh ke aakde par bhi asar padta hai - videshi niveshak ko bharat me nivesh sasta lagta hai, isliye woh vikalp galat hai. Exam point: rupee kamzor = niryat sasta (badhta hai), aayat mehnga (mehngai badh sakti hai); rupee majboot = ulta.

qe: The World Trade Organization, of which India is a founding member, came into existence in which year, replacing which earlier arrangement?
qh: भारत जिस विश्व व्यापार संगठन का संस्थापक सदस्य है, वह किस वर्ष अस्तित्व में आया तथा किस पूर्व व्यवस्था का स्थान लिया?
oe: 1948; replacing the Bretton Woods Agreement
1995; replacing the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade
1991; replacing the United Nations Conference on Trade and Development
2001; replacing the International Trade Organization
oh: 1948; ब्रेटन वुड्स समझौता का स्थान लेते हुए
1995; सामान्य शुल्क तथा व्यापार समझौता (GATT) का स्थान लेते हुए
1991; अंकटाड का स्थान लेते हुए
2001; अंतर्राष्ट्रीय व्यापार संगठन का स्थान लेते हुए
e: DvitIy vishwa yuddh ke baad 1948 me General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT) kandha tha, jiska mukhya kaam vyapaar me shulk (tariff) ghataana tatha vyapaar ke niyamon ko sanchit karna tha. 1994 me Marrakesh samjhauta hua aur 1 January 1995 se World Trade Organization (WTO) astiva me aaya, jisne GATT ka sthan liya - yah Uruguay Round ki baat-cheet ka bada fal tha. WTO ka mukhyalay Geneva (Switzerland) me hai aur bharat uske sthaapak sadasyon me se ek hai. Bretton Woods samjhauta 1944 ka tha jisse IMF aur World Bank bane - woh vyapaar ke niyamon ki sanstha nahi thi, isliye pehla vikalp galat hai. UNCTAD 1964 me vikasheel deshon ke vyapaar ke liye bani alag sanstha hai, aur International Trade Organization (ITO) kabhi poori tarah kaam nahi kar payi (uska idea 1948 ke Havana Charter me tha). Exam point: WTO = 1 January 1995, Geneva, GATT (1948) ka sthan lekar aaya, bharat sthapak sadasya; IMF aur World Bank alag - woh Bretton Woods se 1944 me bane.

qe: Which of the following best distinguishes FDI from FPI?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा FDI तथा FPI के अंतर को सर्वोत्तम ढंग से स्पष्ट करता है?
oe: FDI is a short-term flow traded on stock exchanges, while FPI is a long-term investment in factories
FDI involves a lasting interest and control in a business, while FPI is investment in financial assets such as shares and bonds with no lasting control
FDI is allowed only in the public sector, while FPI is allowed only in the private sector
FDI is recorded in the current account, while FPI is recorded in the capital account
oh: FDI अल्पकालिक प्रवाह है जो शेयर बाजार में कारोबार होता है, जबकि FPI कारखानों में दीर्घकालिक निवेश है
FDI में व्यवसाय में स्थायी हित तथा नियंत्रण होता है, जबकि FPI शेयर तथा बॉण्ड जैसी वित्तीय परिसंपत्तियों में निवेश है, जिसमें स्थायी नियंत्रण नहीं होता
FDI केवल सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र में तथा FPI केवल निजी क्षेत्र में अनुमत है
FDI चालू खाते में दर्ज होता है, जबकि FPI पूँजी खाते में
e: Do tarah ke videshi nivesh me antar unke uddeshya tatha avadhi me hai. Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) me niveshak kisi kamparni me sthayi hit (lasting interest) tatha prabandhan me bhaag ya niyantran chahta hai - jaise ek nayi factory lagana, saahsi (joint venture) banana ya kisi kamparni me bada hissa kharidna. Foreign Portfolio Investment (FPI) me niveshak keval share, bond ya mutual fund ki jamaa kharidta hai, jisse woh kuchh hi samay me nikal sakta hai aur usse prabandhan me niyantran nahi milta. Isi karan FDI sadharan taur par sthir tatha deerghkalin hota hai, jabki FPI mausam ki tarah tezi se aa-jaa sakta hai; maandi me gir hoti hai to FPI nikalne se rupee tatha share bazaar me dabav aata hai. FDI ke liye nivesh ki avadhi tatha niyantran dono mehva hone se woh sahi chayan hai; 'FDI alpkalin aur FPI deerghkalin' wala vikalp ulta hai. Dono hi capital (ya financial) account me darj hote hain, isliye chautha vikalp galat hai; kshetra ke aadhaar par ladai bhi galat hai. Exam point: FDI = sthayi hit tatha niyantran, deerghkalin; FPI = vitteey sampattiyon me nivesh, chalayman, niyantran ke bina; dono capital account me.

qe: The 'trade deficit' of a country means:
qh: किसी देश का 'व्यापार घाटा' का अर्थ है -
oe: The excess of total government expenditure over total revenue
The excess of the value of imports of goods over the value of exports of goods
The excess of foreign exchange reserves over external debt
The excess of the value of exports over imports
oh: कुल सरकारी व्यय का कुल राजस्व पर आधिक्य
वस्तुओं के आयात के मूल्य का वस्तुओं के निर्यात के मूल्य पर आधिक्य
विदेशी मुद्रा भंडार का बाह्य ऋण पर आधिक्य
निर्यात के मूल्य का आयात पर आधिक्य
e: Vyaapaar ghaata (trade deficit) keval vastuon ke vyapaar (merchandise trade) ka farq batata hai: jab ek desh vastuon ke aayat ka mulya niryat ke mulya se zyada ho jaata hai, to usse vyaapaar ghaata kehte hain. Agar niryat zyada ho to use vyaapaar adhiky (trade surplus) kehte hain. Bharat ka vyaapaar aam taur par ghaate me rahta hai, kyunki kachche tel, sona tatha electronic saamaan ke aayat bade hote hain. Iske alava ek bada shabd 'chaalu khata ghaata' (current account deficit) hai, jo vastuon ke saath-saath sevaon (services), aay tatha ek-tarfa hastantaron ko bhi joddta hai - jaise software niryat tatha videsh se aane wali prashansaaon se chaalu-khata ghaata kam hota hai. Isliye vyaapaar ghaate ko chaalu khata ghaata samajhna galat hai aur alag-alag vikalp bhi isi karan banaye gaye hain. Sarkari kharch-raajasva ka farq raajasva ghaata hota hai tatha videshi mudra bhandar tatha bahya rinn ka farq alag vishay hai. Exam point: vyaapaar ghaata = keval vastu aayat minus vastu niryat; chaalu-khata ghaata = vastu plus seva plus aay plus prashansaaon ka ant; vyaapaar adhiky = niryat zyada.
